args.subject: Invitation: Tuesday Evening Book Club (7 PM at the Local Library)
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I’d like to invite you to our book club meeting on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library, and we’re currently reading mystery novels. We’d love for you to join us.

Please let me know if you can make it.

Best regards,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Recommendation: The Artisan Bakery (sourdough)
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to recommend The Artisan Bakery downtown — their sourdough bread is incredible. They bake fresh every morning at 6:00 AM. If you get a chance, try their sourdough; it's worth it.

Let me know what you think.

Thanks!

args.subject: Invitation: Hands-on Italian Cooking Class (Wednesday evening next week)
args.body:
Hi Bob,

I'd like to invite you to a hands-on Italian cuisine cooking class at the Culinary Arts Center next week on Wednesday evening. It's a practical, fun session where we'll make classic Italian dishes together.

Would you be interested in joining? If so, I can send time and registration details.

Best,

args.subject: Recommendation: Rachel — Yoga Instructor
args.body:
Hi Charlie,

I wanted to recommend Rachel — she’s an excellent yoga instructor who teaches at the community center on Tuesdays and Thursdays. She’s great with students of all levels and offers clear, supportive instruction. If you’re interested, I think you’d really enjoy her classes.

If you’d like, I can share her contact info or the class schedule.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Invitation: Book Club — Tuesday Evenings at 7 PM
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I’d like to invite you to our book club on Tuesday evenings. We meet at 7:00 PM at the local library. Right now we’re reading mystery novels and would love to have you join our next meeting.

If you’re interested, please let me know and I’ll share details about the next book and meeting date.

Thanks,
[Your Name]
